title: Pilot who flew the gold out is still alive

tellings.quote: He's still alive. The the commander, the pilot that flew the flew the gold out.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that the commander and pilot who flew a load of gold out at the end of the Second World War, around 1945, is still alive. He does not say much more, but he offers the pilot as a living witness to where that gold went.
